subject: Request to rebook demo — additional security & procurement stakeholders
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Bryce Hartman <bryce.hartman@halcyonhealth.com>, security-lead@halcyonhealth.com, procurement@halcyonhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to rebook demo — additional security & procurement stakeholders

Hi Bryce / Halcyon team,

Thanks again for the interest — really looking forward to the demo. Quick update: I just heard that your security lead and procurement team want to join the session to cover compliance posture and commercial terms. Given that, the originally booked 45-minute slot won't give us enough time to run a full architecture + security walkthrough and the procurement Q&A.

Would you be open to moving to a single 90-minute session so everyone can get air time? If helpful we can also split into a 60-minute product + security walkthrough and a follow-up 30-minute procurement call; happy to align to what works for your stakeholders.

Attached: Agenda-draft.odt and SOC2-summary.pdf for your security folks to scan ahead.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 05/27: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu 05/28: 14:00–15:30

Please send whichever option aligns with your folks or share other times and we'll adapt. Also tagging Marissa and Neha from our side to ensure infra and platform leads are on the thread.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Bryce Hartman <bryce.hartman@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-lead@halcyonhealth.com, procurement@halcyonhealth.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to rebook demo — additional security & procurement stakeholders

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the heads up.

Confirming: our Head of Security (joining remotely) and one procurement representative will need to be present. Also a couple of our product folks are traveling on Wed morning, so Wed morning is tight. Thu 05/28 14:00–15:30 PT would work best on our side if you can accommodate.

Procurement also asked whether we can record the demo and get a short pricing appendix afterward (15 minutes) for commercial alignment.

On Tue, May 25, 2027 at 9:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Bryce / Halcyon team,
> 
> Thanks again for the interest — really looking forward to the demo....

Best,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Bryce Hartman <bryce.hartman@halcyonhealth.com>, security-lead@halcyonhealth.com, procurement@halcyonhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to rebook demo — additional security & procurement stakeholders

Perfect — thanks for flagging constraints. I've attached an updated run-of-show (Agenda-v2.pdf). Plan suggestion: 60 minutes product + security deep dive, 15 minutes open Q&A, and we can stay on for another 15 minutes dedicated to procurement follow-up if needed. That keeps it structured but gives procurement the time they requested.

If Thu 05/28 14:00 PT is the best for you, we'll tentatively hold that slot and I'll send a calendar invite with conference details once internal confirmations are in. If anyone here has a conflict, speak up — Marissa and Neha, can you confirm availability?

Also note: SOC2 summary is attached for the security team and we'll surface the KMS/HSM integration checklist during the walk-through.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Bryce Hartman <bryce.hartman@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to rebook demo — additional security & procurement stakeholders

Karthik / Bryce — I can cover Thu 05/28 14:00–15:30 PT. I'll bring our infra lead (Vivek) and platform lead from the Console team to address any runtime/ops questions. Attached is our infra checklist (infra-checklist.xlsx) that I can walk through briefly during the demo.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Engineer, Redwood Inference

On Wed, May 26, 2027 at 8:30 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Bryce Hartman <bryce.hartman@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-lead@halcyonhealth.com, procurement@halcyonhealth.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to rebook demo — additional security & procurement stakeholders

Thanks — Thu 05/28 14:00 PT is confirmed on our side. We appreciate you pulling in infra and platform.

Can you please: 1) send a calendar invite with dial-in/Zoom details, 2) enable recording so I can share with two colleagues who are on a delayed flight, and 3) schedule a 15-minute follow-up right after the demo for procurement (15:30–15:45 PT) to run through pricing and contracting next steps.

If there's anything you want us to review beforehand, we'll read the Agenda-v2 and SOC2-summary.

Bryce
Director of Engineering Programs
Halcyon Health
